payload.purpose_context: The issue-matrix approval gate reads hex colours as issue numbers, treats commit-SHA evidence citations as work targets, and gates every #N in research and plan prose. Operators then hand-record not-applicable rows for issues the Mission owes no work. This Mission narrows the detector and the one classifier so only real, in-scope issue statements gate approval.
payload.purpose_tldr: Stop the issue-matrix gate from demanding verdict rows for colours, commit citations and research-note numbers.
